title: Love it so far
body: Again, I love it. But it will be nice to have a year-long tracker as well, say visit the dentist 2x a year, for example.
author: factmatics

title: Deletes data without cause
body: This would be a really great app if it didn’t randomly delete your streaks and tasks. It’s quite frustrating losing all that data.
author: Obiwanuju
